title: Soulmate
text: “…Was it really okay for you to live on your own as a middle schooler? Not just in terms of daily life, but socially as well?”
“It wasn’t a problem at all. The pig next door would come wake me up every morning, and the pig—who was known as the landowner’s daughter—even cut me some slack at school.”
“Wow… that’s pretty impressive. Motoyasu, are you actually the protagonist of a gal game or something?”

Did I strike a chord with my future Father? He’s looking at me with great interest. If this were my future Father, he’d probably be sizing me up with a piercing gaze—the kind that sends a chill down your spine—to determine if I’m a suitable match for Filo-tan.
“But even with such ideal circumstances, didn’t anything ever happen between you two?”
“Happen? With a pig? You must be joking.”
“No, I’m just personally curious about Motoyasu-kun back then.”
“When I told everyone I was moving to Tokyo to ‘polish my skills as a man,’ they all smiled and saw me off.”
“R-really?”

Well, after that, we ended up losing touch for over two years. Looking back, they were a bunch of selfish pigs, one way or another. If I did something they didn’t like, they’d immediately sulk, and I’d end up having to smooth things over—it was incredibly exhausting. On top of that, they’d take simple problems—the kind that could be solved in a flash—way too seriously. Back then, I was desperately trying to resolve all of them. Looking back now, I can’t help but wonder why I wasted my energy on such trivial nonsense.

That’s right. If there’s one thing I learned from those pigs that actually came in handy, it’s probably online games. Without them, I might never have met Filo-tan. So, I guess I should at least be grateful for that much.
“Don’t you ever want to go back?”

“Not in the slightest. Even without me, they’re probably getting along just fine with someone who looks like me. That’s just how pigs are. Aren’t they spouting nonsense about ‘getting over the sadness of losing me’ or something like that?”
“…I guess I’d hate a woman like that, too. But Motoyasu-kun, you’re actually pretty cold-hearted, aren’t you?”
“Is that so? That’s just how romance with pigs goes, isn’t it?”
But I’m different. I, who had been wasting my time on pigs, didn’t know what true love was. Ah, to love—it’s such a joyful thing, isn’t it?

Sometimes it’s necessary to put on a facade so the other person doesn’t get upset. But eventually, the cracks will show in that facade. Besides, it’s a clear fact that pigs only wanted to date me because I’m good-looking. If I whisper sweet nothings, most pigs will trust me easily.

But Filo-tan is a rare gem who set me straight without giving my looks a second thought. No one but Filo-tan has ever encouraged me like that without paying any attention to me at all. Pigs try to exploit my weaknesses to gain an edge over other pigs.
I didn’t sense any such ulterior motives from Filo-tan at all. That’s why I, Motoyasu, have resolved in my heart to be devoted solely to Filo-tan and Filolial-sama.
“Well… wait, I’ve gone off on a tangent again. Let me get back on track. So, I’m thinking we should be cautious and consider how the country of Siltvelt treats its heroes.”

Wow, that’s just like my Father. The Father I know has moments of extreme caution—the kind where he’d check and recheck everything, even to the point of breaking a stone bridge—and moments of boldness, like cutting through flesh to sever the bone. Seeing him so cautious—even before the trials of life hardened his gaze—brings tears of emotion to Motoyasu’s eyes.
“Why are you starting to cry, Motoyasu-kun? Were you even listening?”
“What’s wrong with Motoyasu?”
“I’m fine. I’m just deeply moved by my cautious Father.”
“I feel like I’m being made fun of—or is that just my imagination?”
“Not at all.”
“…Well, in Motoyasu-kun’s case, I suppose you really do mean it.”
My father lets out a deep sigh.
“The most likely possibility, for now, is what I discussed with Ms. Eclair during our journey—that you might be entering into a marriage with someone from Siltvelt.”

It’s not entirely out of the question. When I was first summoned, I received all sorts of marriage proposals as well. Back then, I, too, felt disgusted by the pigs who would spread their legs just because I was the “Spear Hero.” Though the Crimson Swine turned them all away.

Back then, I wanted to have physical relationships with the pigs—my trusted comrades. Beyond that, I dreamed of a harem based on casual relationships. I believed that picking up women was a man’s true worth. I even had these nauseating dreams—like, once I saved the world, every pig in the world would be mine… Ugh… Thinking about pigs so much is making me feel sick.
“Motoyasu, stop changing your expression so quickly. It makes me nervous when I’m trying to talk to you.”
“Got it.”
I’ll just listen to Father without thinking about a thing. Yeah, just like always.

“For starters, I’m guessing I’ll start getting invited to matchmaking events, meetings, and dinners starting tomorrow or so. I was summoned to save the world, but it looks like I’m just going to be treated like a stud… Well, I’m a virgin too, so I’d like to try it at least once.”
I’m not thinking about anything at all.
“Motoyasu, are you listening?”
Zoning out…
“Motoyasu!”
“Yes?”
“If you’re not listening, I’m going home.”
“I was listening. But since Father told me not to change my expression, I was just trying not to think about anything.”
Hmm, it seems my Father thinks being a virgin is something to be ashamed of.

“So, back to what we were discussing earlier. Being a virgin is a pure thing. You mustn’t give yourself to a pig. Even now, just thinking about it gives me the chills. The idea of losing my virginity to a pig makes me want to throw up.”
“Ugh… I’ve never felt so sure I’d chosen the wrong person to confide in, Motoyasu-kun.”
“That’s a compliment. Thank you!”
“I’m not complimenting you! Anyway… I was just wondering if you happen to know if I have a ‘soulmate’ or something like that.”
A soulmate, huh? The first person who comes to mind is Filo-tan’s Big Sister. After that, her Big Sister’s Big Sister might have been a candidate as well.

For my part, I absolutely must prevent Filo-tan and my Father from crossing the taboo of incest. Thinking about it that way, wouldn’t Filo-tan’s Big Sister be the most logical choice? But even though her Big Sister and my Father were together for quite a long time, I’ve never heard anything like that. That’s because, back when we were living in the village, Filolial-sama was talking about it…
“I heard that my future Father… was sleeping with men, if I recall correctly.”
“Huh!?”

My Father’s face is twitching. That’s definitely right. I believe my Father… didn’t want to sleep with women, so he had Filo-tan and the village slaves keep watch while he slept with a man. That Hakuko-clan man.
“So, because I was betrayed, my future self ended up becoming a homosexual?”
“I believe… he was a slave destined to become a White Tiger Guy.”

I remember what Filolial-sama and the others said. They said they’d heard my Father sleeping with men. Back then, I was doing all sorts of things at Father’s command, so I don’t really know who he was having relationships with…
“No way… I don’t want to do it with a man…”

Father began to worry, clutching his head. Come to think of it, perhaps Big Sister wasn’t actually Father’s lover. Since Big Sister was more like his own daughter to him, I don’t think they had that kind of relationship. It’s a difficult issue, isn’t it?
“Anyway, I’ll say this loud and clear: virginity and losing one’s virginity are equal things. You mustn’t throw them away carelessly.”
“Is that how it is?”
“Virginity is a status symbol!”
“I’ve never heard a line like that before!”

Father hung his head. What on earth is he so sad about? Virginity is a precious thing that can only be lost once. While there’s no clear proof like there is with virginity, it’s deeply etched into one’s heart. In other words, it’s proof that allows you to proudly tell your destined partner that you possess a pure body.

To begin with, I don’t like that only virginity is considered special. Socially, there’s even a phrase like “virgin snow,” but I wonder why there isn’t a term like “virginity snow.” Anyway, this is the story of the purity I, Motoyasu, dedicated to Filo-tan—a purity I can never regain for the rest of my life.
“It was a mistake to consult Motoyasu-kun…”
“What are you saying? This is an important matter. What if you carelessly sleep with some pig and catch an STD? If you weigh virginity against an STD, isn’t it obvious that virginity is better?”
“Well… what about a virgin?”
“The first pig I had a relationship with in this world was pretending to be a virgin, you know.”
“They can even do that!? Ugh… Fine. I hate men, but I’ll try to avoid marriage proposals as much as possible.”
My Father looked exhausted as he trudged out, taking Sakura-chan with him.
